title: Check: History of the Periodic Table (2) (B)

questions.stem: Mendeleev placed tellurium before iodine despite tellurium having a higher atomic mass. Why?

options.text: He made an error in his calculations
He prioritised chemical properties over strict atomic mass order
He did not know the atomic masses

questions.explanation: Mendeleev prioritised chemical properties over strict atomic mass order. Tellurium has properties similar to sulfur and selenium (Group 6), while iodine is similar to chlorine and bromine (Group 7). Swapping them ensured each element sat with elements of similar properties.
